# Rest Assured Moving LLC

> Licensed moving labor company in Salem, Oregon. We load, unload, pack, unpack, and assemble furniture for customers who arrange their own rental truck, PODS, U-Box, trailer, or storage unit. Labor only: we do not provide trucks, driving, or transportation.

## Key facts

- Business name: Rest Assured Moving LLC
- Type: Moving labor (labor-only movers / moving help)
- Phone: (971) 302-0120 (call or text)
- Email: Shawn@restassuredmoving.net
- Owner: Shawn
- License and insurance: licensed Oregon business; does not currently carry liability insurance
- Based in: Salem, OR 97301 (service-area business, no storefront)
- Service area: Salem, Keizer, Woodburn, Albany, McMinnville, Beaverton, Hillsboro, Tigard, and the Portland Metro area
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM
- Pricing: $95/hour for 2 movers, $130/hour for 3 movers, 2-hour minimum, then 30-minute increments
- Included: moving blankets, shrink wrap, and equipment; no fuel charges, mileage fees, or travel charges within the service area
- Payment: cash, credit/debit card, Venmo, Zelle, Cash App, PayPal
- Quotes: free; reply within one business day, usually same day

## Services

- [Loading](https://[YOUR-DOMAIN]/services.html#loading): loading rental trucks (U-Haul, Penske, Budget), PODS, U-Box and other containers, trailers
- [Unloading](https://[YOUR-DOMAIN]/services.html#unloading): unloading with room-by-room placement
- [Packing and unpacking](https://[YOUR-DOMAIN]/services.html#packing): packing with proper materials; unpacking and setup
- [Furniture assembly and disassembly](https://[YOUR-DOMAIN]/services.html#assembly): beds, tables, shelving, desks, flat-pack (IKEA, Wayfair, Amazon)
- In-home heavy lifting and storage-unit loading

## Typical costs (labor only, ground floor)

- Studio: about $190 to load or unload; $238–$380 for both
- 1 bedroom: $190–$238 one end; $333–$475 both ends
- 2 bedrooms: $285–$428 one end; $585–$845 both ends (3 movers)
- 3 bedrooms: $390–$585 one end; $780–$1,170 both ends
- Instant estimate: https://[YOUR-DOMAIN]/estimate.html

## Not offered

Truck rental, driving, and long-distance or interstate transport (we can do the loading or unloading on the local end), junk hauling, and storage facilities. Pianos, gun safes, and pool tables are assessed case by case.
